main_body: wooden loom frame with vertical warp threads and woven pattern
top_band: medium-light brown horizontal top surface at rows 10-11, bounded by a lighter tan front-edge highlight at row 12
evidence: Reading down the center column: row 9 is dark brown outline; rows 10-11 are a 2px medium brown top surface plus row 12 which is a 1px lighter tan front-edge highlight (3 rows total for the top beam's top plane). Row 13 is a recessed shadow row above the warp threads (rows 14-18) and red/yellow woven cloth (rows 19-21). Rows 22-24 repeat a lower horizontal beam with its own top/highlight (row 23) and front face (row 24), followed by legs at rows 26-31.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul cheese stall and roofed well references, the loom is overly geometric and mechanical: perfectly uniform straight horizontal bands of single colors across the entire 26px width (rows 10-12, 22-24), and a rigid 2x1 checkerboard pattern for the cloth and strictly alternating 1px vertical stripes for the threads without any organic wood grain, specular variation, or Beodeul-level shading depth.
